The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''35,453 before the Battle of Yavin (BBY)''', also known as '''1,000 TYA''', was a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] in the [[pre-Republic era]]. Around that year, [[Osamael Or]] was recorded saying "There are depths" while describing the unexplored regions of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. Around that time, Or wrote ''[[The Gree, and Everything I Have Found of Them in the Old City]]'' as he explored the [[Old City (Tython)|Old City]], though he disappeared not long afterwards.<ref name="DOTJ" />
